pattern.short_summary: One unit of system output is rendered in two or more sensory or representational channels at once — text plus speech, text plus image plus sound, or one language plus another.
pattern.definition: One unit of system output is rendered in two or more sensory or representational channels at once — text plus speech, text plus image plus sound, or one language plus another. The channels carry the same content rather than complementary content, so the user may take up whichever channel suits them. The duplication is deliberate and built into the generation or rendering step.
pattern.structural_signature: A single output item fans out to multiple renderers whose products are presented together (concurrently or in immediate succession), each renderer targeting a different channel. The channels are redundant with respect to content: removing one loses a way of receiving the item but not the item itself.

dimension.category_description: How interaction crosses sensory, physical, spatial, embodied, or representational channels.
dimension.classification_boundary: The channel, embodiment, or rendering must be the load-bearing interface mechanism.
